question: Does adding relevant exposed Jurkat responses improve cross-assay molecular selection on a separately reserved 2021 scifi experiment?

sources.GSE92872: training captures1-5; development checkpoint selection capture6; these are not independent biological replicates
sources.GSE168620/GSM5151370: all responses reserved; cross-platform same cell line, not unseen cellular context

eligibility: Single unambiguous guide target; >=5 assigned cells per response group and >=5 explicit control cells per context. Keep every eligible target and every exclusion, independent of response. Barcode-negative is not control. Guide detection is not functional knockout verification.
identityAudit: Resolve original GEO accession, batch, intervention, controls; animals count only if source-identified. Assay-level pooling conflicts block animal-level promotion. Xenium requires accessible counts, guide assignments and resolved animal overlap before admission.
representation: No pretrained cell representation. Target representation: pinned UniProt reviewed protein sequence amino-acid frequencies, log length, hashed GO terms. No perturbation expression used in target descriptors. Mouse mapping uses source MGI one-to-one human orthology only. Target descriptor absence is an exclusion, never an unknown-gene biological prediction.
features: 512 highest variance training-control genes common to admitted expression axes, plus predefined objective genes when common. log1p(CPM) uses total endogenous source RNA before feature restriction. No test effect gene selection.
nativeModel: Existing VivoCellResponseMLXModel, hidden64, marginal Gaussian response. Receiver control expression plus separate target descriptors, CRISPR modality, species/context and fixed-geometry relationship. No increase in width.

budget.selection: equal-source equal-target validation response RMSE; no reserved target outcomes

spatialBoundaries: Receiving populations use their own admitted control-reference RNA and uncertain projected types. Geometry-only edges require same verified section; unknown section prohibits biological spatial edges. Chip coordinates are not physical microns. If section membership cannot be verified, edge ablation is unavailable, not replaced by invented tissue adjacency.
selection: Include no intervention with zero change. Lexical tie break. Utility=-mean(objective delta)-penalty*mean(abs(preserved receiver delta)). Seal candidates, objective, rankings and all model predictions before reveal. Missing receiving support prohibits a preservation objective.
uncertainty: Cell variability, mean sampling variability and transfer uncertainty distinct. Split-cell agreement only within-study sampling diagnostic. No biological intervals unless at least three independent resolved evaluation units; no confident winner without qualified transfer uncertainty.
promotion: Original thresholds unchanged; one new source experiment cannot provide three independent evaluation units. Preserve point successes/failures separately.
acquisition: Budget3; rank by model disagreement, compare least-covered and uniform random (1000 fixed seed draws); measure best observed eligible regret. No active-learning claim from disagreement alone.
calibration: Development-only oracle identity, wrong identity, twice magnitude, opposite response, average and zero predictions; retain sensitivity failures; never revise v0.3 verdict.
stopping: One three-checkpoint campaign and two predeclared stimulation contexts; no further changes after reveal.
revision: bounded cross-assay follow-up; before GSE168620 outcome access
baselineClarification: Target/context-matched training-mean response when available; otherwise modality mean. Original v1 target-agnostic mean retained unchanged.
